panel.title: Seven Fortunes’ Blessing
panel.body:
Choose one of the Seven Fortunes. The Clans listed for a Fortune buy it for 1 point less.

Benten’s Blessing (4 XP, 3 for Crane) — +0k1 on a Social Skill Roll made to persuade someone. Persuasion only — not coercion.

Bishamon’s Blessing (5 XP, 4 for Crab or Lion) — +1k0 on Strength Trait Rolls. Also: declaring and making three successful Raises for Increased Damage on an attack earns one additional Raise; Free Raises do not count.

Daikoku’s Blessing (4 XP, 3 for Mantis) — +1k1 on all Commerce Skill Rolls.

Ebisu’s Blessing (4 XP, 3 for Unicorn) — +1k1 on Social Skill Rolls made with citizens of Rokugan who are not samurai.

Fukurokujin’s Blessing (4 XP, 3 for Dragon or Phoenix) — Choose one Lore Skill when you buy this. +1k1 on Skill Rolls using that Lore Skill.

Hotei’s Blessing (4 XP) — When any effect would make you lose Void Points, whoever caused it must first beat you in a Contested Void Roll. If the effect already calls for a Contested Roll, your roll gets +10 instead.

Jurojin’s Blessing (4 XP, 3 for Scorpion) — +2k0 on rolls to resist the effects of a disease or poison.

panel.title: Dark Paragon
panel.body:
Choose one precept of Shourido. Once per session, as a Free Action, sacrifice 5 Honor points to invoke it; only if you do not have 5 Honor points may you spend a Void Point instead. The roll gains +5, except where a precept says otherwise.

Cost 5 XP, or 4 for a Spider character.

Control: Reroll any Social Skill Roll, with +5 to the reroll.
Determination: Negate every TN and Wound penalty on one Skill Roll or Spell Casting Roll. No +5.
Insight: Reroll a roll that used Awareness, with +5 to the reroll.
Knowledge: Reroll a roll that used Intelligence, with +5 to the reroll.
Perfection: Make one chosen die on a Skill Roll explode. No +5.
Strength: Reroll any damage roll, with +5 to the reroll.
Will: Negate 10 Wounds at the moment you suffer them.

The sheet takes the payment when you confirm, never on preview or cancel. The four rerolls keep the reroll, not the higher result. Reset the use at the start of each session.

pickers.name: Darling of the Court
pickers.gridText: Darling of the Court Name each court you have purchased Court 1RemoveAdd courti Each court is a separate purchase: 2 XP each, 1 XP for a Courtier. A court can be listed only once. You choose the selected court and whether it is in session on the sheet.

panel.title: Darling of the Court
panel.body:
Core p.148 — reference, not an automatic effect.

Choose a court. While you attend it and its court is in session, your Status counts as one Rank higher there. Your actual Status Rank, and everything calculated from it, is unchanged.

You may buy this again for a different court, but only once for any particular court. Each court costs 2 XP, or 1 XP for a Courtier.

Examples, not a complete list: the court of Kyuden Bayushi; the court of Toshi Ranbo’s Okura district.

This sheet shows the higher Status only for the one court you select, and only while “Court in session” is ticked.

Courtier price: does not apply — no Courtier School recorded. A School counts when its name or its bracketed type says Courtier.

panel.title: Paragon
panel.sub: Reference — Core p.152, not automatic effects
panel.body:
Choose one tenet of Bushido. Whenever you gain Honor for showing that virtue, gain 1 more Honor. Cost 7 XP, or 6 for a Lion character.

This sheet records the tenet and reminds you of it; it does not change dice, spend Void or award Honor.

Compassion: When a Void Point improves a roll made to directly help someone lower in the Celestial Order, it gives +2k2 instead of +1k1.
Courage: +1k1 on rolls to resist Intimidation or overcome Fear.
Courtesy: +2k0 on Etiquette rolls to avoid embarrassment or a breach of honor.
Duty: A Void Point can negate every TN penalty, including Wound penalties, on one Skill or Spell Casting roll.
Honesty: +1k1 on Sincerity (Honesty) rolls, even without that Emphasis when it would fit.
Honor: Use twice your Honor Rank instead of the normal Honor contribution when resisting Temptation or Intimidation.
Sincerity: +2k0 on Contested Rolls using Sincerity.

Honesty: +1k1 on Sincerity (Honesty) rolls, even without that Emphasis when it would fit.

panel.title: Soul of Artistry
panel.body:
Choose Artisan Skills or Craft Skills. When a matching Skill would be rolled Unskilled, it is rolled as Rank 1 instead: Trait + 1 dice rolled, Trait kept, and 10s explode. A Skill you have trained is unchanged, and no bought Rank or XP changes.

Artisan: the Artisan Skill and its specializations (Artisan: Painting, Poetry, Bonsai…); Calligraphy counts as Artisan.
Craft: the Craft Skill and its specializations (Craft: Blacksmithing, Cooking…); Engineering, Sailing and Forgery count as Craft.

Cost 4 XP, or 3 for a Crane or a Courtier (one reduced price, not two).

panel.title: Touch of the Spirit Realms
panel.body:
Choose one Spirit Realm. Cost 5 XP (Toshigoku 8, Yomi 7); a Shugenja pays 4, and by this sheet’s reading 7 for Toshigoku and 6 for Yomi. The book does not print those two Shugenja prices; you may want to confirm them with your GM.

Chikushudo (4 XP) — +1k1 on all Animal Handling rolls. Added automatically to Animal Handling rolls.

Gaki-do (4 XP) — When you resolve an attack that kills an opponent, immediately regain 5 Wounds. Reminder: heal the 5 Wounds yourself.

Jigoku (4 XP) — Requires Shadowlands Taint. Add your Taint Rank to attack rolls and to Skill and Trait rolls using a Physical Trait; if you are Lost, add twice your Taint Rank. Added automatically from your Taint Rank; tick Lost when you are.

Maigo no Musha (4 XP) — When you are awarded more than 3 points of Glory, gain one more. Reminder: add the extra Glory yourself.

Meido (4 XP) — +2k0 on Contested Rolls against social manipulation, such as Courtier. Tick it in the roll preview when it applies.

Sakkaku (4 XP) — +1k1 on Sincerity (Deceit) rolls. Tick it in the preview of a Sincerity roll when you are lying.

Tengoku (4 XP) — +2k0 on Earth Ring Rolls to resist Shadowlands Taint. Tick it in the preview of an Earth Ring Roll when you resist Taint.

Toshigoku (7 XP) — A Move Action taken to get into attack range moves you 5 extra feet. Reminder: add the 5 feet yourself.

Yomi (6 XP) — Choose one School Skill; +1k0 on Skill Rolls using it. Added automatically to rolls of your chosen School Skill.

Yume-do (4 XP) — Four hours of rest recover all your expended Void Points, instead of a full night’s rest. Reminder: restore your Void Points yourself.

panel.title: Void Versatility
panel.body:
Choose one non-Void Ring when you buy this. Its spell slots may then pay for Void spells as well as for its own spells. The spell is still a Void spell: same Casting Roll, same effects. Only the slot that pays changes.

When you cast a Void spell, the sheet asks which slot pays: the chosen Ring, or the ordinary Void slots (with the shared bonus pool after them, as before). ✕ cancels and spends nothing.

Shugenja with a Void Affinity only. Uncentered forbids it. Cost 4 XP.

Not in effect on this character: Requires a Void Affinity — your School's Affinity is Earth.

panel.title: Darling of the Court
panel.body:
Core p.148 — reference, not an automatic effect.

Choose a court. While you attend it and its court is in session, your Status counts as one Rank higher there. Your actual Status Rank, and everything calculated from it, is unchanged.

You may buy this again for a different court, but only once for any particular court. Each court costs 2 XP, or 1 XP for a Courtier.

Examples, not a complete list: the court of Kyuden Bayushi; the court of Toshi Ranbo’s Okura district.

This sheet shows the higher Status only for the one court you select, and only while “Court in session” is ticked.

Courtier price: does not apply — no Courtier School recorded. A School counts when its name or its bracketed type says Courtier.

panel.title: Paragon
panel.sub: Reference — Core p.152, not automatic effects
panel.body:
Choose one tenet of Bushido. Whenever you gain Honor for showing that virtue, gain 1 more Honor. Cost 7 XP, or 6 for a Lion character.

This sheet records the tenet and reminds you of it; it does not change dice, spend Void or award Honor.

Compassion: When a Void Point improves a roll made to directly help someone lower in the Celestial Order, it gives +2k2 instead of +1k1.
Courage: +1k1 on rolls to resist Intimidation or overcome Fear.
Courtesy: +2k0 on Etiquette rolls to avoid embarrassment or a breach of honor.
Duty: A Void Point can negate every TN penalty, including Wound penalties, on one Skill or Spell Casting roll.
Honesty: +1k1 on Sincerity (Honesty) rolls, even without that Emphasis when it would fit.
Honor: Use twice your Honor Rank instead of the normal Honor contribution when resisting Temptation or Intimidation.
Sincerity: +2k0 on Contested Rolls using Sincerity.

panel.title: Soul of Artistry
panel.body:
Choose Artisan Skills or Craft Skills. When a matching Skill would be rolled Unskilled, it is rolled as Rank 1 instead: Trait + 1 dice rolled, Trait kept, and 10s explode. A Skill you have trained is unchanged, and no bought Rank or XP changes.

Artisan: the Artisan Skill and its specializations (Artisan: Painting, Poetry, Bonsai…); Calligraphy counts as Artisan.
Craft: the Craft Skill and its specializations (Craft: Blacksmithing, Cooking…); Engineering, Sailing and Forgery count as Craft.

Cost 4 XP, or 3 for a Crane or a Courtier (one reduced price, not two).

panel.title: Touch of the Spirit Realms
panel.body:
Choose one Spirit Realm. Cost 5 XP (Toshigoku 8, Yomi 7); a Shugenja pays 4, and by this sheet’s reading 7 for Toshigoku and 6 for Yomi. The book does not print those two Shugenja prices; you may want to confirm them with your GM.

Chikushudo (4 XP) — +1k1 on all Animal Handling rolls. Added automatically to Animal Handling rolls.

Gaki-do (4 XP) — When you resolve an attack that kills an opponent, immediately regain 5 Wounds. Reminder: heal the 5 Wounds yourself.

Jigoku (4 XP) — Requires Shadowlands Taint. Add your Taint Rank to attack rolls and to Skill and Trait rolls using a Physical Trait; if you are Lost, add twice your Taint Rank. Added automatically from your Taint Rank; tick Lost when you are.

Maigo no Musha (4 XP) — When you are awarded more than 3 points of Glory, gain one more. Reminder: add the extra Glory yourself.

Meido (4 XP) — +2k0 on Contested Rolls against social manipulation, such as Courtier. Tick it in the roll preview when it applies.

Sakkaku (4 XP) — +1k1 on Sincerity (Deceit) rolls. Tick it in the preview of a Sincerity roll when you are lying.

Tengoku (4 XP) — +2k0 on Earth Ring Rolls to resist Shadowlands Taint. Tick it in the preview of an Earth Ring Roll when you resist Taint.

Toshigoku (7 XP) — A Move Action taken to get into attack range moves you 5 extra feet. Reminder: add the 5 feet yourself.

Yomi (6 XP) — Choose one School Skill; +1k0 on Skill Rolls using it. Added automatically to rolls of your chosen School Skill.

Yume-do (4 XP) — Four hours of rest recover all your expended Void Points, instead of a full night’s rest. Reminder: restore your Void Points yourself.

panel.title: Void Versatility
panel.body:
Choose one non-Void Ring when you buy this. Its spell slots may then pay for Void spells as well as for its own spells. The spell is still a Void spell: same Casting Roll, same effects. Only the slot that pays changes.

When you cast a Void spell, the sheet asks which slot pays: the chosen Ring, or the ordinary Void slots (with the shared bonus pool after them, as before). ✕ cancels and spends nothing.

Shugenja with a Void Affinity only. Uncentered forbids it. Cost 4 XP.

Not in effect on this character: Requires a Void Affinity — your School's Affinity is Earth.
